messages:
maria: ran the nightly eval with quantized-ggml-8bit and noticed a weird spike in the 95th percentile vs baseline. median looks unchanged, which is odd. :thinking:
vikram: which job id?
maria: eval-runner-nightly #9022. CI diff shows 95th up ~7.9 pts, median +/-0.2.
ash: any config differences? maybe bucket boundaries or dedupe toggles.
kai: also check for retries during ingestion — we had storage flakiness earlier.
maria: runner config snippet:
```
runner:
  name: eval-runner
  version: v3.7.4
aggregate:
  strategy: percentile
  buckets: [50,75,90,95,99]
  window_seconds: 3600
  dedupe: false
```
jen: ops-bot logged a transient storage outage this morning, might be related. @ops-bot can you share incident?
ops-bot: [incident-618] transient storage timeouts 2026-03-18T08:03Z — retries triggered, affected CI runs: nightly/9008-9030
vikram: if ingestion retried batches and dedupe is off, duplicate rows would bias percentile aggregation, especially tail buckets.
nash: I dug into agg/merge.py locally — merge() can double-count if partial windows overlap and we don't de-duplicate by sample id. there was a FIXME about stable key ordering.
maria: repro logs from a local run:
[2026-03-18T08:03:12Z] ingest: initial batch 1000 rows
[2026-03-18T08:03:13Z] ingest: retry batch 100 rows due to timeout
[2026-03-18T08:03:15Z] aggregator: partial A buckets {50:500,75:720,90:860,95:910,99:995}
[2026-03-18T08:03:16Z] aggregator: partial B buckets {50:0,75:0,90:0,95:100,99:0}
[2026-03-18T08:03:17Z] aggregator: merged {50:500,75:720,90:860,95:1010,99:995}
ash: B was the retried batch. merge added counts without checking ids -> 95th inflated. explains isolated 95th jump.
kai: two immediate mitigations: flip dedupe:true for nightly runs, and disable CI auto-retries for ingest path until we patch. also add a unit test for merge idempotency.
jen: I'll mark the scorecard diffs from those job ranges as suspect and add a dashboard note: "95th percentile anomaly under investigation — ingestion retries + aggregator merge semantics".
vikram: action list:
- maria: enable dedupe:true for nightly evals and kick a rerun
- ash: patch agg/merge.py to use sample ids or stable hashing on merge, add idempotency guard
- kai: add CI unit test that merges overlapping partial windows and asserts counts equal unique sample set
- jen: correlate incident windows with affected scorecard history and annotate/flage entries
- ops-bot: add CI guard to limit automatic ingest retries to 1 and surface retry counts in run metadata
maria: queued a new nightly with dedupe=true. tagging existing diffs as flaky.
ops-bot: [CI] eval-runner-nightly #9023 queued with dedupe=true
vikram: long-term we should also add a dashboard signal rule: if 95th changes >5% while median <1% and sample_count_delta <2x, auto-flag for manual review.
kai: will draft a PR for that alert rule. also picking up the merge unit test.
jen: once patch + tests land, let's plan a backfill to recompute aggregates for the incident window or mark them as invalid in historical scorecards.
maria: thanks everyone — quick triage. follow-ups in linked threads. :thumbsup:
